description:
You are one of several personnel managers at an airline deciding which candidate to hire as a long-haul pilot. Each manager has read different interview notes and reference letters.

The options are:
- Candidate A (Fengarlu Belmir)
- Candidate B (Lunolke Nepoltal)
- Candidate C (Fenumelu Valynke)
- Candidate D (Ridaxlu Fenwel)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which candidate should be hired? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.
